Class GreenhouseRadiativeEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.GreenhouseRadiativeEngine
public class GreenhouseRadiativeEngine extends Object
Radiative Greenhouse Effect, Stefan-Boltzmann Equilibrium invalid input: '&' Clausius-Clapeyron Dynamics Engine.

Fundamental Model Physics Equations

  • Stefan-Boltzmann Radiative Balance: $$\epsilon \sigma T^4 = \frac{S_0}{4}(1 - \alpha) + \Delta F_{\text{GES}}$$
  • Clausius-Clapeyron Saturation Vapor Pressure: $$e_s(T) = e_0 \cdot \exp\left( \frac{L_v}{R_v} \left( \frac{1}{T_0} - \frac{1}{T_K} \right) \right)$$
  • CO2 invalid input: '&' CH4 Radiative Forcing: $$\Delta F = 5.35 \ln\left(\frac{[\text{CO}_2]}{[\text{CO}_2]_0}\right) + 0.036\left(\sqrt{[\text{CH}_4]} - \sqrt{[\text{CH}_4]_0}\right)$$
